name: Western Australian law: every Act with a consolidated version, version by version
label: Western Australia
record_note: Every Western Australian Act with a consolidated version on the WA Legislation website (811 in force, 475 repealed), from its first consolidated version (the earliest 1886-09-02) to the last version in force on or before 2026-10-29; data downloaded 28 October 2026 to 29 October 2026. Amendments made before an Act's first consolidated version are inside that first text.

dates.time: 12:00 Perth (AWST, UTC+8; UTC+9 in the daylight-saving trials of 1974-75, 1983-84, 1991-92 and 2006-09)
dates.before_1970: dated 1970-01-01 one second apart; the day is in In-force

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: repeal or amendment does not affect previous operation or accrued rights; common-law presumption against retrospective operation
default_reach.meaning: unless the contrary intention appears, the repeal of a written law does not affect its previous operation or any right, privilege, obligation or liability acquired, accrued or incurred under it; laws are presumed not to operate retrospectively on substantive rights
default_reach.authority: Interpretation Act 1984 (WA) s 37 (text in this corpus); Maxwell v Murphy (1957) 96 CLR 261 (common law; not checked here)

verification: Every version is read back from git on its first day and compared with the source: the files equal the parser's rendering byte for byte, and the letters and digits of the whole Act equal those of the raw HTML read by an independent extractor (cover page, table of contents and note-reference numbers excepted).
